summary: Real Messenger Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program. On August 20, 2026, the board approved repurchases of Class A ordinary shares up to $2.0 million over two years. Repurchases may occur via open market, Rule 10b5-1 plans, or private negotiations under Rule 10b-18. Funding comes from cash on hand; the program is discretionary and can be suspended anytime. No price per share, premium, or advisor was specified. Watch for repurchase pace and any future buyback expansions.
